name: What is a multi-level deck and how does it differ from a single-level deck?
description: A multi-level deck has multiple sections at different heights, connected by stairs, offering zoned outdoor living space compared to a single-level design.

mainEntity.name: What is a multi-level deck and how does it differ from a single-level deck?

acceptedAnswer.text: A multi-level deck features two or more distinct sections at varying heights, connected by stairs or landings. Unlike a single-level deck, which typically extends from one elevation of a home, a multi-level design allows for zoning different activities, such as dining, lounging, or a hot tub area, across its footprint. This can be a practical tradeoff, as it offers more versatile outdoor living spaces but often requires more complex design and engineering due to varying elevations and support structures.
